status: exploratory follow-up after the original FD001 test results were seen
selection: Lowest mean validation RMSE across tuning seeds 0 and 1; fixed original engine split. No test data loaded by training.
budget: Eight candidates, two tuning seeds each; selected candidate reported for seeds 0, 1, 2. No additional search after test evaluation.
common_design: Train-only standardisation; sigmoid output times the fixed 125-cycle cap; MSE; AdamW; validation learning-rate reduction and early stopping. Same 30-cycle, 14-sensor information as original models.
evaluation: Freeze sources, data, preprocessing, plan and all selected checkpoints before one descriptive evaluation of the already-used official test set. Report every seed and mean/std. Compare three-seed ensembles for ALL models, never ensemble-vs-single only.
acceptance: Do not claim the neural upgrade wins unless measured results support it. Lower test error on this reused benchmark is descriptive, not fresh confirmation of generalisation.
